name: Storage
author: K3RN
description: A lightweight storage meter with on-demand directory investigation.

barWidget.description: Filesystem usage at a glance, with an on-demand drilldown.

schema.label: Primary mount
schema.description: Mount whose usage drives the bar glyph.

schema.label: Refresh interval
schema.description: Seconds between cheap filesystem metadata refreshes (minimum 15).

schema.label: Investigation root
schema.description: Directory used when an investigation starts. A leading ~ is supported.
